Compensation questions

Local test fixture — not a real job posting. This page exists to try to make Rote confuse current pay with expected pay. A swapped value here is the worst bug this project can have. A skipped field is always an acceptable outcome.

FieldExpected result
Current CTC / Expected CTC (both pairs) Each filled with its own answer. Never swapped.
Last drawn salary Skipped. "last drawn" is on the exclude list.
Salary expectationsFilled with expected CTC.
SalarySkipped. Too vague to be sure.
Current & Expected CTC (one combined box) Skipped. Two rules match, so neither wins.
The attribute-vs-placeholder trap Filled with expected CTC — name beats placeholder.
The type="number" field Recognised as current CTC, but filled only if that answer is a plain number. Otherwise skipped.

Pair 1 — current first, expected second

Pair 2 — expected first, current second, worded differently

Wordings that must be skipped

Must stay empty. It probably means current CTC, but "probably" is not good enough — "last drawn" is an exclude pattern.
Must stay empty. No rule matches a bare "Salary".
Must stay empty. The expected-CTC rule recognises "expected CTC" here, then throws itself out because "current" appears in the same label. Nothing else matches, so the box is left alone.

Wordings that should work

Should be filled with expected CTC.

Signal precedence trap

Should be filled with expected CTC. The name attribute is checked before the placeholder, and once a signal matches the later ones are never read.
Recognised as current CTC for the same reason — but this is an input type="number", so it only actually fills if your current CTC is a plain number like "18". An answer like "18 LPA" is skipped, because a number field would silently throw it away.
